mapper.select:
SELECT id, user_id, store_id, receipt_image_id, receipt_status, rating, content
FROM review
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.store_id, v.rating, v.content, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at
FROM review v
JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
WHERE v.store_id = #{storeId}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.store_id, v.rating, v.content, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at
FROM review v
JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT rv.store_id, IFNULL(AVG(rv.rating), 0) AS avgRating, IFNULL(COUNT(rv.rating), 0) AS reviewCount FROM review rv
JOIN root r ON rv.id = r.id
WHERE rv.store_id = #{ storeId } GROUP BY rv.store_id

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(v.rating), 0), 1) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{lookbackDays} DAY), 0) AS recentCount
FROM review v
JOIN root r ON r.id = v.id
WHERE v.store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.store_id, v.rating, v.content, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at
FROM review v
JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
WHERE v.id = #{reviewId}

SELECT rv.store_id
FROM review rv
JOIN root r ON r.id = rv.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
WHERE r.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY rv.store_id
ORDER BY MAX(rv.id) DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT rv.content
FROM review rv
JOIN root r ON r.id = rv.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
WHERE rv.store_id = #{storeId} AND rv.content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(rv.content)) > 0
ORDER BY rv.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT rv.store_id
FROM review rv
JOIN root r ON r.id = rv.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
GROUP BY rv.store_id
ORDER BY MAX(rv.id) DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
FROM review v
JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
WHERE v.id = #{reviewId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( id, user_id, store_id, rating, content, receipt_image_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{receiptImageId} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE review v
JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
SET v.rating = #{review.rating}, v.content = #{review.content}, r.updated_at = NOW()
WHERE v.id = #{reviewId} AND v.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete:
UPDATE review v
JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
SET r.deleted_at = NOW()
WHERE v.id = #{reviewId} AND v.user_id = #{userId}
